gates.summary: Every function full, linked to the registry or bodiless.
The X1 sweep clean in the module's own functions.
Every record answered: filled in, or none with the reason.
The eight description sections; Interactions describes the records in prose.
Every function in IsrIrqTable keeps its Isr_Irq<NNN> or Isr_IrqShared_<NNN> prefix with the number the import gave it.

inapplicable_tools.hint: NDS32 has a single code mode; the language is fixed by the profile.
An EC has no port-0x80 POST codes; what it sends the host is in host_commands.
An EC module has no PPIs or protocols: its records are irq_map, host_commands, ec_ram, smbus_peers, gpio and eflash_area, kept for now as ### subsections of Interactions in the description.
An EC module records no interfaces; read its description's Interactions.
EC firmware has no GUIDs to name.

records.summary: The EC's flash data area past the image extent: every range or address the code reads, writes or erases there; the function that does it; the record format; and what it holds (state bytes, logs, settings). Write the meaning only from the code. A dump's contents are never the meaning, because they differ between reads and a host update rewrites them up to host_update_size.
